title: Citation Needed: Provenance for LLM-Built Knowledge Graphs — Daniel Chalef, Zep AI
talk_summary: Zep's Daniel Chalef describes engineering provenance into LLM-built knowledge graphs: source episodes are kept verbatim as graph nodes, and every derived entity/fact links back to its sources so lineage survives entity merges, fact invalidation, and source deletion. He also notes they deliberately avoid LLMs where cheaper deterministic techniques (simhash, entropy, traditional IR/NLP) suffice for dedup and deconfliction.

takeaways.technique: Provenance-by-construction in the data structure, not post-hoc logs
takeaways.what_they_do: Store source artifacts verbatim as nodes and link every derived artifact back to its sources as graph edges, so tracing a fact is a graph walk rather than a separate append-only log that drifts as data mutates.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Lineage needs to be built in to the data structure, engineered into the data structure, which is a graph, not logged afterwards.

takeaways.technique: Multi-parent veracity policy per fact type
takeaways.what_they_do: When a derived fact has multiple sources, expose which sources carry a 'verified' tag and let the agent apply business rules: some facts need only one verified parent, others need every parent verified.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the facts are very similar shapes. They have three three parent episodes but opposite policies.

takeaways.technique: Prefer deterministic dedup/deconflict over LLM calls
takeaways.what_they_do: In the ingestion pipeline they use traditional IR/NLP (simhash, entropy) for deduplication and deconfliction instead of LLMs wherever possible, reserving LLM calls for extraction.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we try very hard not to use LLMs in this process as well ... far cheaper, far faster, deter more more far more deterministic.

takeaways.what_they_do: They engineered extraction so entities, relationships, and facts come out in one LLM call rather than a multi-step chain, which they say made it cheap.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we've managed to get um a singleshot extraction working that extracts entities and the relationships between them and facts.

takeaways.technique: Tag inheritance at ingestion for retrieval filtering
takeaways.what_they_do: Tag source episodes at ingestion (e.g. 'EHR'); all derived entities/facts inherit the tag, so retrieval can filter by veracity with one tagging action.
takeaways.evidence_quote: one tagging action at ingestion supports evaluating the veracity of a fact.

takeaways.technique: Deletion rule based on surviving support
takeaways.what_they_do: A derived fact is deleted only if no remaining source supports it; facts with other surviving parents persist when one source is removed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: A fact is only deleted if no remaining episodes support it.
